# assessed norm

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assessedNorm`](gmeow-assessedNorm.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessedNorm>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The norm against which the event is assessed. Functional: one assessment, one norm.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md) -> [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:assessedNorm`](gmeow-assessedNorm.md) from [`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md) to [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md), [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md) to name the single norm against which the event is judged.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one norm per assessment (it is functional — mint a separate assessment per norm) and avoid naming the event here (that is [`gmeow:assessedEvent`](gmeow-assessedEvent.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:assessedNorm`](gmeow-assessedNorm.md) once from the assessment to its [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md), paired with [`gmeow:assessedEvent`](gmeow-assessedEvent.md) and [`gmeow:complianceVerdict`](gmeow-complianceVerdict.md).
